purpose: Turn F_gap, F_next, uncertainty, TOKEN_VAZIO, provenance, urgency, contracts, indices, governance, data, privacy and security into reconstructible bounded work units with explicit authority, gates and stopping conditions.
mother_invariants: urgency orders execution; urgency does not increase truth
hash proves identity/integrity properties; hash does not prove truth
repository-local authority governs local implementation; Mapa governs federated routing/state
cross-repository claims require evidence at every claimed producer/consumer boundary
historical receipts are append-only; corrections supersede without erasing

system_roles.Mapa: federated authority, routing, current-state reconciliation, relation graph, gaps, claim boundaries and governance decisions
system_roles.RafGitTools: executor/control-plane/tool-router for deterministic selection, validation, ledgers, checks and transitions
system_roles.AGENTS.md: repository-local entry adapter that binds identity, local authority, indices, boundaries and executable routes
system_roles.Google_Drive: longitudinal, transversal and orthogonal memory plus editorial reconstruction and durable navigation anchors
system_roles.producer_repository: authority for implementation details, local build/test contracts and domain-specific runtime behavior
system_roles.receipt: evidence bridge between execution, state transition, provenance and federated reconstruction

entry_questions.question: Qual rota do Mapa corresponde ao objetivo?
Quais regras de governança, dados, privacidade e segurança governam esta unidade?

gap_unit_contract.unknown_policy: An unknown required field is represented as a typed TOKEN_VAZIO with cause, dependencies and next gate; it is never omitted or guessed.
gap_unit_contract.resolved_policy: RESOLVED and RESOLVED_NEGATIVE require exact evidence refs and an observed exit criterion/falsifier result.
gap_unit_contract.ready_policy: READY_TO_TEST requires implementation evidence but remains unresolved until the exit criterion is observed.
gap_unit_contract.mutation_policy: HIGH/CRITICAL mutation requires a rollback reference before execution.

priority_policy.rule: Select the highest-urgency work item that can reduce a named uncertainty with an observable gate while respecting dependency order and non-compensatory privacy/security/governance blockers.
ordering: upstream dependency blockers before downstream consumers
READY_TO_TEST with executable falsifier before speculative redesign
cross-repository blockers with larger dependency impact before isolated cosmetic debt
oldest unresolved observation when otherwise tied
forbidden: skip blocker because another dimension scores high

stop_conditions: Goal is reconstructible and opening more history would not change gate, evidence, contradiction, provenance, privacy/security classification or authority.
A mandatory dependency or authority is unavailable; record BLOCKED/TOKEN_VAZIO and stop mutation.
A privacy/security/governance gate fails; fail closed and emit receipt.
Exit criterion is observed; emit evidence-bound transition and do not expand scope automatically.
The next action would require authority outside the current role; route to that authority instead of acting by inference.

receipt_contract.cross_repo_rule: A receipt from one repository cannot promote another repository's local/runtime claim without a compatible receiving-side receipt or explicit bounded federation decision.
